app.name: justtranscribe
app.label: JustTranscribe
app.description: Turn audio files, voice notes, meetings and public video links into searchable, timestamped text.

modules.name: watchCompletedTranscripts
modules.label: Watch Completed Transcripts
modules.description: Triggers when a transcript finishes processing.

modules.name: watchTranscriptEvents
modules.label: Watch Transcript Events
modules.description: Triggers the moment a transcript sent to this webhook URL finishes or fails.

modules.name: transcribeUrl
modules.label: Transcribe a Media URL
modules.description: Starts a transcription from a public video or audio link.

modules.name: transcribeFile
modules.label: Transcribe a File
modules.description: Uploads an audio or video file and starts its transcription.

modules.name: getTranscript
modules.label: Get a Transcript
modules.description: Returns one transcript with its text, segments and AI analysis.

modules.name: downloadTranscript
modules.label: Download a Transcript
modules.description: Downloads a finished transcript as a file: SRT, VTT, TXT, MD, CSV, PDF or DOCX.

modules.name: deleteTranscript
modules.label: Delete a Transcript
modules.description: Deletes a transcript and the stored media that belongs to it.

modules.name: listTranscripts
modules.label: List Transcripts
modules.description: Returns the transcripts on the connected account, newest first.

modules.name: makeApiCall
modules.label: Make an API Call
modules.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized API call.
